<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1929776_compli_0.CPMConst</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CPMConst</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CPMConst = Class.create();
CPMConst.prototype = {
  PREFIX: 'x_1929776_compli_0',   // scope prefix
  VERSION: '18',                  // must match the widget build
  CHUNK: 400,                     // ids per "sys_id IN (...)" query
  MAX_FILES: 10,                  // files per submission
  ID: /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/,           // a complete sys_id

  initialize: function() {
    var p = this.PREFIX;
    this.TABLE = {
      CONTROL: p + '_control', MAPPING: p + '_mapping', EVIDENCE: p + '_evidence',
      CI: 'cmdb_ci', SERVICE: 'cmdb_ci_service', RELATION: 'cmdb_rel_ci', USER: 'sys_user'
    };
    this.ROLE = { ADMIN: p + '.admin' };
    this.EVENT = {
      SUBMITTED: p + '.evidence.submitted', APPROVED: p + '.evidence.approved',
      REJECTED: p + '.evidence.rejected', DIGEST: p + '.owner.digest',
      ASSIGNED: p + '.control.assigned', TEAM: p + '.team.digest'
    };
    this.STATE = { MISSING: 'missing', AWAITING: 'awaiting', APPROVED: 'approved', REJECTED: 'rejected', EXPIRED: 'expired' };
    this.STATUS = { DRAFT: 'draft', PENDING: 'pending', APPROVED: 'approved', REJECTED: 'rejected', SUPERSEDED: 'superseded' };
    this.RISK = { GREEN: 'green', YELLOW: 'yellow', RED: 'red', NOT_ASSESSED: 'not_assessed' };
    this.VIEW = { EXPIRING: 'expiring', UNCOVERED: 'uncovered' };
  },

  // list('a', 'b') gives 'a,b'
  list: function() {
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments).join(',');
  },

  // true for a complete sys_id
  isId: function(text) {
    return this.ID.test(String(text || ''));
  },

  type: 'CPMConst'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-29 15:58:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>52702d687318db10a621f2024ab8b7d3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CPMConst</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper" source="x_1929776_compli_0">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_52702d687318db10a621f2024ab8b7d3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-02 23:24:28</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
